One complete, working example ships in
[`examples/demo-deck/`](https://github.com/jprybylski/deckifyr/tree/main/examples/demo-deck):
a real project you can `cd` into and build yourself. It's built from
base R's built-in `Theoph` dataset, so no external data is needed, and
it ships a pre-generated `OUTPUTS/` (the same figure/metadata sidecar
[quartifyr's `examples/demo-report`](https://github.com/jprybylski/quartifyr/tree/main/examples/demo-report)
produces from that dataset), so it builds immediately after a clone.

## [`demo-deck`](https://github.com/jprybylski/deckifyr/tree/main/examples/demo-deck): a five-slide PK deck

A small PK-style deck built entirely from `design.yaml`/`layouts.yaml`/
`presentation.yaml` -- no manual slide editing. It exercises a real
`{rpfy}:conc-time.png` reportifyr reference (resolved by
`deckifyr.resolvers.ReportifyrResolver` against `OUTPUTS/` and its
metadata sidecar, with a footer built from `standard_footnotes.yaml`),
two real `type: quarto` fragments (spec section 8.1) -- a display-math
equation rendered to a picture, and a real R code chunk executed to
produce editable native text -- a `table` element resolved from a CSV
into a native, fully-editable PowerPoint table with its own
`table_styles` chrome, a two-zone `plot-with-note` layout reused by both
the reportifyr and the quarto slide, speaker notes, and
`z_index`/`rotation` on a freeform closing slide. `design.yaml` also
exercises a `background_gradient` (a sequential-blue linear gradient
painted as the slide's own native fill), a faint brand-tinted logo
composed over it via `background_image`, and a diagonal, translucent,
centered "DEMO" watermark: `furniture.status.watermark`, one of several
named placements `design.yaml` may configure (`corner_tr`/`corner_tl`/
`corner_bl`/`corner_br` are the simpler, corner-pinned alternatives),
angled via `rotation` and, via a high `z_index`, painted on top of every
ordinary element instead of behind it -- the conventional watermark
placement, kept legible by its own `text_styles` entry's `opacity`.
`presentation.yaml`'s own `status_indicator: watermark` picks that
placement, and its text comes from `metadata.status: demo` (no separate
`watermark:` field set) uppercased by that same `text_styles` entry's
`text_transform: uppercase` -- for this specific build only, not baked
into `design.yaml` as always-on.

Building it requires the external `quarto` binary (and, for the R code
chunk, `Rscript`) on `PATH` -- see
[`examples/demo-deck/README.md`](https://github.com/jprybylski/deckifyr/tree/main/examples/demo-deck#readme)'s
own note. `inst/examples/minimal-deck/` (below) has no such requirement.

```bash
uv run deckifyr build examples/demo-deck/presentation.yaml
# -> examples/demo-deck/build/demo-deck.pptx, demo-deck.manifest.json
```

```r
deck_build("examples/demo-deck/presentation.yaml")
```

`status_indicator` (spec section 7.8) isn't limited to the full diagonal
`watermark` placement above -- `design.yaml` also configures
`corner_br`/`corner_tr` (simpler, upright, corner-pinned alternatives;
`corner_tl`/`corner_bl` are the same idea, just not configured in this
particular demo), styled independently from `watermark`'s own diagonal
look. This deck's own `presentation.yaml` doesn't select one -- the
render below swaps `status_indicator: watermark` for `corner-tr` in an
otherwise-identical copy of the project (see
[`examples/demo-deck/README.md`](https://github.com/jprybylski/deckifyr/tree/main/examples/demo-deck#readme)
for the exact reproduction steps), just to show the alternative
placement actually composed:

<p style="font-size:0.85em;">Title, with <code>status_indicator: corner-tr</code> instead of <code>watermark</code> (not part of this deck's own tracked build)</p>
</div>

## Starting your own project

`deckifyr init` scaffolds the smaller, three-file
[`inst/examples/minimal-deck/`](https://github.com/jprybylski/deckifyr/tree/main/inst/examples/minimal-deck)
trio instead of `demo-deck` -- a minimal valid project to build on, not
a demo of every feature:

```bash
uv run deckifyr init my-deck
uv run deckifyr validate my-deck/presentation.yaml
uv run deckifyr build my-deck/presentation.yaml
```

```r
initialize_deck_project("my-deck")
deck_validate("my-deck/presentation.yaml")
deck_build("my-deck/presentation.yaml")
```
